description: This file defines the JsonFactory class, which serves as the main API for creating, parsing, and manipulating JSON objects, arrays, values, and related constructs within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory methods, parsers, builders, and utility functions specific to JSON data handling.

classes.name: JsonFactory
classes.description: Provides factory methods, parsers, builders, and utilities for creating and manipulating JSON data in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: newKey
methods.description: Creates a new JSON key with the specified character sequence value.

methods.name: nullLiteral
methods.description: Returns the JSON literal representing null.

methods.name: getAppropriateValue
methods.description: Guesses and returns a JsonValue representation for a given Java object.

methods.name: newValue
methods.description: Creates JSON value literals for boolean, int, long, double, and String values.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or stream into a JsonValue.

methods.name: newObjectBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for JsonObject.

methods.name: newObject
methods.description: Creates JsonObject instances from strings, maps, or iterable of JsonFields.

methods.name: nullObject
methods.description: Returns a null JsonObject literal.

methods.name: newArrayBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for JsonArray.

methods.name: newArray
methods.description: Creates a new empty JsonArray or from string.

methods.name: nullArray
methods.description: Returns a null JsonArray literal.

methods.name: newField
methods.description: Creates a new JsonField with specified key and value.

methods.name: newPatch
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPatch for JSON modifications.

methods.name: newPointer
methods.description: Creates a JsonPointer from root and sub-level keys or from a string.

methods.name: emptyPointer
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer.

methods.name: newParseOptionsBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for JsonParseOptions.

methods.name: newFieldSelector
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector from string, set of JsonPointers, or JsonPointer(s).

methods.name: parseJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: newStringFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for String type.

methods.name: newBooleanFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for Boolean type.

methods.name: newIntFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for Integer type.

methods.name: newLongFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for Long type.

methods.name: newDoubleFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for Double type.

methods.name: newJsonArrayFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for JsonArray type.

methods.name: newJsonObjectFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for JsonObject type.

methods.name: newJsonValueFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldDefinition for general JsonValue type.
